item.title: Netanyahu viajó a EAU para pedirle desmentir que advirtió de un ataque antes del 7-O, según AP
item.description: Según fuentes citadas por la agencia de noticias estadounidense AP, el primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, se reunió con el presidente emiratí, Mohamed bin Zayed, y le pidió que negara una investigación del diario 'Haaretz', cuyas fuentes sostienen que ese líder lo había alertado sobre una gran operación de Hamás poco antes de los ataques del 7 de octubre de 2023 que detonaron la escalada de hostilidades contra Gaza. item.title: Trump ‘flips & flops’ with Iran between making a deal and threats to attack in ‘devastating fashion’
item.description: François Picard is pleased to welcome Barbara Slavin, Distinguished Fellow at the Stimson Center. She describes the US-Iran conflict as a dangerous combination of military escalation, diplomatic ambiguity and political calculation. Slavin sees an absence of true diplomacy: The recent indirect contacts between Washington and Tehran, mediated by Qatar, has been too limited and too fragile to produce any serious breakthrough. For her, this amounts to “kabuki diplomacy”: they half engage while positioning themselves against any appearance of compromise. Fuente: France 24 - English.

Las autoridades británicas investigan posibles vínculos con Rusia o Irán. Londres ya ha acusado a esos países de utilizar intermediarios para realizar acciones delictivas en territorio británico. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: As midterms approach, does GOP have a Trump problem?
item.description: The US midterm elections are just five weeks away - and while the US President is not on the ballot, his influence is top of mind for Republicans. Donald Trump's approval ratings have been hitting record lows in recent weeks, and in a sign of the party's concern it has started pouring campaign funding into many seats once considered safe, and some candidates have even changed their tune on one of the election's biggest issues: The US's war in Iran. Fuente: France 24 - English.
